action.instructions: Context controller: which context action should be taken before the agent's next step so that the whole session stays cheap in billed tokens without losing task-critical facts?

criteria.noop: do nothing: keep the history as it is (cheapest when the history is small or the prompt cache is warm)
criteria.clm_edit: edit the context: have the agent fold task-critical facts into compact slots and drop the raw history (pays off when the history is large)
criteria.rlm_offload: offload the largest old block into the kernel and keep a one-line reference; answer later with llm_query over the sub-context
